_doc: The /diag check list. web/build.py validates it, expands each file list (with the byte sizes it wrote) and publishes it as dist/diag_checks.json; diag.js probes every entry live from the browser. This static site calls no external API (the robot and the behaviour service are on the local network, never reached from here), so the checks cover the deployed bundle.

checks.name: page
checks.label: Showcase page
checks.purpose: The home page and its stylesheet are served

checks.name: status-page
checks.label: Status page
checks.purpose: This page and its probe script are served

checks.name: version
checks.label: Build version
checks.purpose: version.json carries the same stamp as this page (no stale or mixed deploy)

checks.name: screenshots
checks.label: Screenshots
checks.purpose: Every screenshot on the home page is served and decodes

checks.name: external
checks.label: External services
checks.purpose: APIs, databases or model files this site calls
checks.detail: None: the showcase is static. The robot, its behaviour service and the twin run on the local network and are never called from this site
